elements.name: Early boot audio probe does not block supervisor bring-up

steps.name: I wait for the serial output to contain "SPROUT: Starting early audio stack"
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Audio stack worker running"
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Early audio device"
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Entering supervisor service loop"

elements.name: Audio drivers are available for hardware-backed boots

steps.name: I wait for the serial output to contain "DEVD CATALOG: registered driver '/drivers/virtio_sound'"
the serial output should contain "DEVD CATALOG: registered driver '/drivers/chime'"
the serial output should contain "DEVD CATALOG: registered driver '/drivers/hdaudio'"
the serial output should not contain "KERNEL PAGE FAULT"

elements.name: Startup chime is skipped when no audio device is present

steps.name: I wait for the serial output to contain "SPROUT: Early audio driver started, but /dev/audio/card0/out0 did not appear"
the serial output should not contain "SPROUT: Audio stack launched chime"
the serial output should not contain "KERNEL PAGE FAULT"
